title: Roubaix Pro
notes: Official US page read 2026-11-01: US$29.99, down from US$49.99; endurance road tire for smooth and rough roads; 120 TPI; foldable bead; GRIPTON compound; Endurant casing and BlackBelt flat protection. Sizes as labelled: '700 x 23mm/25mm, psi 115-125, approximate weight 260g' and '700 x 25mm/28mm, psi 85-95, approximate weight 300g'. A separate 2Bliss Ready version is sold for tubeless use.
